messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 5xx rate + gateway timeouts observed on dedicated cluster `oxford-usa-1` affecting tenant `oxfordpress`. Spike started ~2026-03-15T03:11:00Z. Paging @maria-oncall (primary). severity=P1

maria-oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on the page, pulling dashboards and recent deploys. Any active rollouts?

lee-infra: No active model rollouts in that region in the last 2 hours. Seeing sustained increase in upstream `gateway.p95` and backend `inflight_queue_length` on nodes serving oxfordpress.

maria-oncall: Copy. Symptoms = 502/504 gateway, some timeouts, token streaming cuts. Is this noisy-tenant or cluster-level saturation?

ops-bot: Metric snapshot: oxfordpress requests: +6.2x baseline, KV cache evictions: 18k/min, GPU utilization ~92% on pool `ded-oxf-1`, queue depth per-core: 160 -> saturating batching window.

lee-infra: Looks like per-tenant burst pushing KV cache thrash -> worker stall -> 502s. Hypothesis: single tenant generating long-context streams and filling KV, causing paging to disk on nodes.

maria-oncall: Ok let's triage: 1) reduce tenant headroom (soft QPS), 2) enable async-prefetch GC for KV, 3) reroute new requests to fallback model variant (quantized) to shed GPU. I'll run step 1 now.

maria-oncall: Running command:
```
redwoodctl tenants throttle set --tenant oxfordpress --qps 35 --scope region=oxford-usa-1
```

maria-oncall: Command applied, setting soft qps to 35. Applying 10s cooldown to avoid thundering herd.

lee-infra: Applying KV GC flag on nodes: `--kv-async-gc=true` via runtime flags on pool. Pushing now.

ops-bot: KV GC flag rollout started to 6/8 nodes, expected effect in ~45s.

maria-oncall: Also initiating reroute for new requests to `model-x-small` fallback for oxfordpress:
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant oxfordpress --fallback model-x-small --region oxf-1
```

sam-acctmgr: I'm going to ping the customer's SRE (cc @oxf-sre) to let them know we're mitigating and may see degraded quality. Keeping them in the loop.

lee-infra: Logs (truncated):
```
[03:12:15Z] worker=ded-oxf-1-03 evicting KV key shard=0 size=12MB -> swap: true
[03:12:16Z] worker=ded-oxf-1-03 inflight=178 queued=145 latency=820ms errors=5xx
[03:12:18Z] grpc(gateway): downstream timeout -> upstream reset (code=14)
```

maria-oncall: After throttle + KV GC + fallback: ops-bot metrics show 5xx dropping. p95 gateway latency fell from 1.2s -> 420ms over last 90s.

ops-bot: 5xx rate for oxfordpress: 65% -> 9% in last 3m. GPU utilization falling to 74%. Queue depth down to 48.

sam-acctmgr: OxfordPress says they saw a short outage window (~3m) and are switching some critical traffic to their backup endpoint. They asked for root cause and ETA to full recovery.

maria-oncall: Root cause summary (preliminary): tenant-driven sustained long-context traffic causing KV cache thrash and worker-level paging/latency leading to gateway timeouts. Mitigation applied: tenant soft-QPS, KV async-GC, fallback routing.

lee-infra: We'll create a short-lived QoS rule to prevent future similar spikes from a single tenant: `per-tenant inflight cap` for ded pools. I'll open ticket for product to consider automatic tenant backpressure.

maria-oncall: For now, I'm going to hand off to @aj-oncall-na for night coverage with checklist:
- oxfordpress throttle still applied (qps=35)
- KV GC flag rolled to all nodes (status: 6/8 -> pending)
- fallback route active to model-x-small (monitor for quality complaints)
- run `redwoodctl diagnostics latency --tenant oxfordpress --since 10m` every 15m until stable

aj-oncall-na: Taking handoff. I'll watch for recurrence and coordinate with lee if we need to evict/relocate tenant to extra capacity. Please paste any aux creds I need.

maria-oncall: No creds required; all actions via redwoodctl. Current links: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/oxfordpress?range=30m, runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/ops/tenant-noisy-neighbor.

sam-acctmgr: I'll send a consolidated incident note to OxfordPress: what we did, what we recommend (rate-limits, session timeouts, smaller model option), and offer a follow-up call tomorrow.

ops-bot: KV GC rollout completed to 8/8 nodes at 03:21:10Z.

aj-oncall-na: Observed small blip at 03:27 but no re-escalation. Keeping throttle in place for now; will start gradual relaxation to qps=60 in 1h if 5xx stays <2%.

maria-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated for now. Creating post-incident ticket and tagging eng-runtime + product. Please file notes and set follow-up for automated per-tenant backpressure feature.

sam-acctmgr: OxfordPress acknowledged mitigation and accepted callback tomorrow. No SLA credits requested yet.

incident-bot: Incident note (prelim): P1 -> mitigated. Primary impact window ~03:11:00Z - 03:21:00Z. Customer impact: degraded/failed requests for oxfordpress, short outage for some flows, fallback routing in effect.

aj-oncall-na: Leaving a final checklist in the thread: confirm KV GC persists after node restarts, confirm fallback removed when safe, create evict/relocate playbook for ded pools. I'll watch until 04:30Z then hand to morning oncall.

maria-oncall: Thanks team. Good catch on KV thrash hypothesis and fast throttle. Closing live thread, will add postmortem link once ticket created. :thumbsup:
